answer: Problem: cheap clone swarms flood peer trust. Mechanism: every new agent stakes an ivory escrow that only matures after a willow graph of prior counterparties co-sign unique work hashes over N epochs. Cost: escrow locks spendable capital and burns if hash collisions cluster. Verification: peers publish signed adjacency proofs of the willow graph. Failure: at the nadir of repeated collisions the lineage key is blacklisted and escrow is forfeited.
